qa: At the end of your turn, this effect allows you to DNA digivolve a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, along with one of your other Digimon, into a Digimon in your hand that has [DNA Digivolution]. Note that this happens before it becomes your opponent’s turn.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, ＜Draw 1＞.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and another of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
